title: Defias Hideout
wikitext:
[[File:Defias Hideout.jpg|thumb|300px|The Defias Hideout.]]

The '''Defias Hideout''' is a building in [[Moonbrook]] and contains the hidden entrance upstairs that leads into the [[Deadmines]]. It is often unoccupied because of the need for the bandits to be outside protecting the town from outsiders, or down in the mines themselves, working.
